attributes.action: Provide comprehensive statutory support for endometriosis sufferers.
attributes.additional_details:
Endometriosis affects 1 in 10 women in the UK. Ten-year diagnostic delays leave sufferers without legal or financial safety nets.
Statutory measures must:
• Healthcare: Funding for fast diagnosis, free prescriptions, and holistic care (physio, nutrition, pain management).
• Workplace: Recognise fluctuating conditions under the Equality Act 2010.
• Finance: Guarantee PIP access, create self-employed tax reliefs (Trading Allowance/Class 4 NICs), and enhance SSP.
End the decades of silent pain.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to introduce a statutory framework providing healthcare funding, employment protections, a holistic care pathway, and robust financial support—including National Insurance and income tax relief models—for all individuals diagnosed with endometriosis.

rejection.details:
We notice that you are in Wales, where healthcare is devolved. You may wish to start a petition at the Senedd:

https://petitions.senedd.wales/

We have a lot of endometriosis-related petitions already open which you may wish to sign:  

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions?state=open&q=endometriosis

Some relate directly to one or more of the requests in your own petition:

Add Endometriosis to NHS Medical Exemption List for Free Prescriptions
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768916
Fund private healthcare for gynaecology wait list to clear the NHS backlog
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768569
Significantly increase dedicated funding for endometriosis
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766449
